title: Men's Christmas – Drew Your Name. Panicked. Tee
hook: Every office Secret Santa in two beats: DREW YOUR NAME. Panicked. This funny Secret Santa gift is for the guy who just pulled a coworker's name out of a Santa hat and has no idea what they like, and it works just as well on the coworker who drew him. Wear it to the gift exchange, or give it as the Secret Santa gift itself (a good Secret Santa gifts for men pick under the usual $25 limit).
art: The print is a 1950s office-party cartoon: a man in a short-sleeve shirt and narrow tie stares wide-eyed at the paper slip in his raised hand while sweat flies off his forehead, with an upturned red Santa hat full of folded slips and a clumsily taped gift with a crooked bow on the desk in front of him. DREW YOUR NAME. runs across the top in red slab capitals and Panicked. sits below in black script.
wear: Wear it to the office party, the break-room gift swap or any family drawing of names, or hand it to the coworker who always takes the exchange too seriously.
qa: What is the Drew Your Name. Panicked. tee?

It is a men's Christmas graphic tee from Graphic Tees Co. showing a sweating 1950s office worker, a Santa hat full of name slips and a taped-up gift, lettered DREW YOUR NAME. Panicked. It is printed on a Bella+Canvas 3001 in 4.2 oz cotton, so it stays light at a crowded office party.
How does the unisex tee fit?

This Graphic Tees Co. tee is a classic unisex cut in sizes S through 4XL with a crew neck and side-seamed body. Order your usual size for a regular fit or size up one for a looser look. If the size is off, the first exchange is free within 30 days.
How do I wash it so the print lasts?

Wash your Drew Your Name. Panicked. tee inside out in cold water and tumble dry low. It is 100% combed ring-spun cotton at 4.2 oz, with some polyester in the heather colors, and the red, mustard and green inks stay crisp through every holiday party and wash.
Is it a good gift for an office exchange?

Yes. At $24.99 from Graphic Tees Co. it fits under the usual $25 to $30 office Secret Santa limit, and it is a safe pick for a coworker with a dry sense of humor. The free size exchange within 30 days covers a wrong guess on size.
Can I get it by Christmas?

Order by about December 8 and your Graphic Tees Co. Drew Your Name. Panicked. tee should arrive before Christmas. Each shirt is printed the day you order it, so ship times vary a little by location. Orders over $45 ship free, and the free size exchange covers a wrong guess.
